session_read: Cash is the story, not KOSPI. A weekend of self-funded diversification (TSM+2, IREN exited, META/AMZN/BABA/QBTS entered) drained the wallet to $38 (0.095% of book) right as gate flipped ESCALATING on a lone KOSPI -5.17% move -- confirmed by smith-catalyst as mechanical giveback of Friday's +17.9% melt-up, not a new catalyst. 12 of 30 names sit over their ATR-based risk cap (aggregate open risk 14.84% vs a 10% cap); Memory/Storage is the one hard cluster breach (21.7% vs 20% ceiling). Strategist proposes trimming SNDK/MU/ORCL/MRVL (~$2,120) to cure the breach and rebuild cash to ~5.4% ahead of AMD's binary earnings print tomorrow (08-04) and NFP on 08-07. smith-quality's first-ever audit landed a fresh red flag mid-run: MRVL's interest coverage collapsed 8.1x->1.4x on a new $2B debt draw -- the strategist vetoed averaging into MRVL on that basis alone, overriding its own STRENGTHENING technical thesis for sizing purposes.
